name: engineering-workflow
description: Complete Codex software engineering workflow with repository setup, phase routing, large multi-session planning, implementation, and delivery.

interface.shortDescription: Repository setup, workflow routing, planning, implementation, and delivery
interface.longDescription: A complete software engineering workflow plugin. It initializes repository-specific workflow conventions on manual request, offers optional next-stage navigation through ask-matt, separates discovery from clarification, supports manual Wayfinder planning for large multi-module work across sessions, and covers Specs, design review, Tickets, TDD, implementation, code review, delivery, and post-merge cleanup.
defaultPrompt: $ask-matt 评估当前工程任务并路由到合适阶段
